answer: Each agent on our network must answer random spot-check tasks with a TPM quote showing a measured kernel. That quote has to come from a chip no other ID has used this month, so one chip backs one identity. A farm with 200 fakes needs 200 physical boards, each replying within 4 seconds. Relaying a quote over a bridge to a shared host blows the deadline. Rented cloud chips answer at glacier pace and get dropped. Each extra fake adds one more board plus its power bill.
